heroChanges.summary: A Berserker who enters the Feral state by breaking the enemy's wound. Masha's core gameplay has been revamped. We want her to thrive as a high-skill ceiling Berserker capable of sustained combat, rather than an Assassin limited to split-pushing or burst damage.

details.note: Masha has 3 HP bars and dies only when the last one is depleted. Masha gains Feral when dealing damage to heroes or creeps. Feral converts to HP when out of combat. Masha leaves a Wound on the enemy when dealing skill damage to them. Attacking again with a Basic Attack from the direction of the Wound will break it, putting Masha into the Feral state. While in the Feral state, her next 3 Basic Attacks become wide-range claw strikes, and she gains massive Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed.
Masha releases energy forward, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing enemy heroes.
Masha dashes in the target direction, unleashing a wide-range claw strike upon reaching max range or colliding with a non-minion enemy unit. This skill's cooldown resets each time she loses a life.
Masha charges toward the target hero, dealing Physical Damage and stunning them, while knocking back nearby enemies.

heroChanges.summary: A Marksman who deals massive damage to enemies by continuously kicking powerballs. We've made several optimizations to Bruno. While preserving his core identity, we've improved his controls and made adjustments across his kit. These changes make him a more agile and formidable striker.

details.note: We believe the original Volley Shot placed too much burden on players. In the current environment, players might fail to pick up the Powerball even after planning their movement and positioning correctly. Therefore, we've optimized it.

The landing distance of Powerball now scales with Bruno's Movement Speed. The Movement Speed boost is now granted when kicking the Powerball instead of upon dealing damage. The Movement Speed boost now decays over time. The landing position of Powerball will no longer cross walls. Powerball can now be cast even when affected by control effects (except Silence). Powerball now remains on the ground for 3s, up from 2s. Multiple Powerballs can now be retrieved separately. Fixed an issue where Bruno would occasionally lose a Powerball while performing his two-Powerball combo. Now casting the skill no longer interrupts Basic Attacks.
We believe the original skill effect might lead players into relatively dangerous positions. Therefore, we've redesigned the skill to focus more on assisting players with pursuit or escape.

Adjusted the default direction of dash effects to the joystick's direction. Now, when Bruno's Powerball begins to bounce back after dealing damage while he is sliding with Flying Tackle, it will tend to land near his dash destination instead of his starting position.
Removed Powerball's pullback effect. Bruno now gains a Powerball when his slide ends.
Removed the damage effect.

We believe the original skill had too many effects, making it difficult to understand and use correctly. Therefore, we've redesigned the skill to focus on initiating team fights from a distance and rapidly gaining Passive stacks.

It now applies a brief stun and a massive decaying slow effect on the first target hit, and no longer reduces Physical Defense. Optimized the knockback effect on the first target hit. The target will now be knocked back to Bruno's maximum attack range. Energy Ball now prioritizes enemy heroes when bouncing between enemy units.

heroChanges.summary: Aulus takes too long to ramp up, struggles to finish off enemies, and lacks survivability in extended fights. We're addressing these issues by accelerating his ramp-up, condensing his damage into a shorter window, and improving his HP Regen.

details.note: After dealing skill damage to a unit, Aulus gains 2s of Enhanced Basic Attacks (up to 4s).

Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing damage to targets in a line and recovering his own HP, while applying a slow effect to them. During this state, his Attack Range and Attack Speed are increased.

details.attribute: Enhanced Basic Attack's HP Regen (Per Hit)
details.note: 30 (+ 15% Total Physical Attack)
The first cast grants Hybrid Lifesteal upon hitting a target.
The first cast stuns targets hit for 0.3s. The second cast can now be used even if the first cast doesn't hit a target.

heroChanges.summary: Based on your feedback, we've decided to make another round of balance adjustments and gameplay improvements to Argus. Argus can now trigger Demonic Slash more often and stun enemies with Skill 2. The increased Ultimate damage helps him counterattack or secure kills.

details.note: Argus gains 30% initial Crit Chance.
Argus's Crit now triggers an additional Demonic Slash instead of dealing extra damage, but can still trigger other critical-hit effects, including those from Berserker's Fury and Windtalker.
After a charge, he thrusts his Meteoric Sword, dealing damage and stunning targets hit. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra Attack Speed bonus.
Meteoric Sword no longer Crits. Its damage now scales with Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
Damage now benefits from 40% of Crit Chance and Crit Damage.

If the Ultimate is not on cooldown and Argus takes fatal damage, the Ultimate automatically triggers death immunity for 4s, but does not deal damage. The Ultimate's damage increases as Argus's HP decreases, by up to 50%, reaching the maximum when his HP falls below 30%.

heroChanges.summary: Exp Lane heroes need to serve as a primary force in early-game skirmishes. Aldous's reliance on Skill 1 stacks for damage forced him to farm passively in the early game, leaving him completely out of sync with the team's pace. To boost his early-game combat capability and income while keeping his core playstyle intact, we've made the following adjustments.

details.attribute: Gains a shield on the 3rd Basic Attack, Cooldown
details.to: Gains a shield on the next Basic Attack every 8s

details.note: Upon gaining a shield, Aldous gains 60% extra Movement Speed for 1s.
Gains 20% Movement Speed when moving toward enemy heroes while the skill is active.
Gains 5 stacks of Soul Steal if the attack hits an enemy hero.

details.attribute: Soul Steal Stacks Gained on Siege Minion / Other Non-hero Unit Kill
Soul Steal Stacks Gained on Enemy Hero Kill
Soul Steal Stacks Gained on Siege Minion Kills by Nearby Allies
Bonus Damage per Soul Steal Stack

details.note: Removed the Movement Speed boost.

heroChanges.summary: Lukas was slightly weak in the Exp Lane but too strong as a jungler. To make him stronger in the Exp Lane while preserving his jungler playstyle, we've made some adjustments to him.

details.note: Added a fan-shaped hitbox in front of Skill 1 when used in human form with 0 stacks.
Lightning damage after Flash Strike now only triggers once.

heroChanges.summary: We've noticed that Classic Zilong was a bit too strong, even proving hard to handle in Classic mode. As a result, we've reduced his damage and how often he gains Control Immunity. That said. Even after these adjustments, Classic Zilong can still pick off enemy heroes amid the chaos of battle.
We've slightly increased Classic Akai's damage and adjusted his Ultimate's knockback frequency to match that of the current Akai.

details.attribute: Extra Basic Attack Damage Based on Max HP

details.note: Increased the Ultimate's knockback frequency.

heroChanges.summary: To make Odette feel more like a graceful dancer, she can now move freely at a slightly reduced speed while casting her Ultimate.

details.note: The second cast has been removed. Odette can now move freely at a slightly slower speed during her Ultimate.
Increased the bounce speed and frequency of Passive's sound wave during the Ultimate.

heroChanges.summary: We've noticed that roaming Sun takes too many resources away from his teammates, negatively affecting their experience. We've therefore made targeted adjustments to rein in his roaming build while minimizing the impact on his performance in other lanes.

details.note: To offset the changes to the Doppelganger's cooldown and attributes, we've adjusted some values of Sun's Passive to keep its overall effectiveness unchanged.
The Doppelganger inherits all of Sun's attributes, but the damage it deals is reduced, and it takes extra damage.
150% The skill will not enter cooldown while the Doppelganger is present. For balance, we've reduced the skill's base cooldown.

details.from: Enemy Gold Reward for Killing a Doppelganger: 26 (+ 1.5 * Game Time in minutes)

details.note: The Doppelganger inherits all of Sun's attributes, but the damage it deals is reduced, and it takes extra damage.
120% The skill will not enter cooldown while the Doppelganger is present. For balance, we've reduced the skill's base cooldown.

heroChanges.summary: Improved Marcel's skill synergy with other heroes, allowing him to work better with a wider range of heroes. As a balance adjustment, we've slightly reduced his early-game damage and skill cast frequency. Marcel can now interrupt skills that require selecting a target location before dealing damage (e.g., Eudora's Ultimate and Vexana's Skill 2).

details.note: Location-targeted skills can now be frozen by "Golden Hour".

heroChanges.summary: Kalea's damage and survivability as a Fighter-Support have both fallen short this patch, making her one of the weakest supports right now. To address this, we've decided to give her a comprehensive buff so she can truly perform as a Fighter-Support.

details.note: The Passive's third Basic Attack will still trigger while Kalea is affected by control effects.

heroChanges.summary: Increased Kadita's Movement Speed when roaming to the side lane in the early-to-mid game.

details.note: Gains 10% Movement Speed while in the River.

heroChanges.summary: Hylos's previous passive effects were underwhelming, so we've adjusted them to make his growth attributes more consistent.

details.note: Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana gained from equipment or emblems.
Hylos gains 1 extra Max Mana for every 2.5 Extra HP gained.

heroChanges.summary: Slightly increased the hero's early-to-mid-game damage against high-HP units, the speed of killing the EXP Crab in the early game, and sustainability in team fights.

details.attribute: Spell Vamp Per Stack of Delight

heroChanges.summary: Melissa's Skill 1 provided too much Attack Speed for too long, while Muddles summoned by Skill 2 dealt excessive Basic Attack damage. We've reduced Skill 1's Attack Speed bonus and duration, as well as Muddles' damage transfer ratio and the percentage of Attack Effects inherited.

details.to: 52% (now matches the Basic Attack damage transfer ratio)

heroChanges.summary: Miya's team fight damage and farming speed in the current patch exceeded expectations. We've fixed an issue where Moonlight Shadow's Split Arrow dealt abnormal damage and incorrectly triggered Attack Effects, and slightly reduced Miya's damage to single targets.

details.note: Fixed an issue where Miya's Split Arrow (Moonlight Shadow) dealt incorrect damage and incorrectly triggered Attack Effects.

heroChanges.summary: Hanabi dealt excessive damage to a single target through consecutive Petal Blade bounces in small-scale team fights. To preserve her single-target poke during the laning phase, we haven't changed her base bounce damage. Instead, we've added a bounce damage falloff: when a Basic Attack or skill bounces repeatedly hits the same target, subsequent bounces deal less damage, limiting her sustained output against a single target within a short time.

details.note: When Hanabi's Basic Attack or skill bounces hit the same target repeatedly, subsequent bounces deal 30% less damage.

heroChanges.summary: Yi Sun-shin's overall mobility was too high, so we've increased Skill 1's cooldown to limit his dash frequency.

Alpha's early-game laning was relatively weak, so we've adjusted his Passive to scale with Total Physical Attack, improving his early- to mid-game performance. We've also optimized Skill 2's Regen mechanics by increasing its base HP recovered per hit and reducing the additional HP recovered per hit, improving its sustain when hitting a single target.

details.from: Recover HP for each enemy hit
details.to: Recover HP when hitting an enemy (healing decays by 40% for subsequent enemies hit).

heroChanges.summary: Improved the feel of controlling the Seimei Umbrella when Kagura repositions in battle.

details.note: The Seimei Umbrella's Movement Speed now increases based on the distance traveled per movement.

heroChanges.summary: Slightly increased Edith's initiative and flexibility.

details.note: Edith can now pass through walls when ejecting herself from Phylax.
While inside Phylax, Edith can gain Wrath by dealing skill damage to targets.
Gains extra Movement Speed while flying.
Edith can now pass through walls when ejecting herself from Phylax.
Knockback no longer deals damage to nearby enemies.

heroChanges.summary: We aim to increase Karina's Skill 1 usage frequency and improve the effectiveness of her Enhanced Basic Attack.
To prevent Paquito from snowballing too quickly and zoning enemies out of lane, we've slightly reduced his early-to-mid-game burst damage.
Slightly increased Kaja's HP Regen.

details.note: Kaja now gains additional HP Regen equal to 45% of his Total Magic Power.
